title: Tom and His Sport
text:
Tom likes sport. Every morning he runs in the park. He jumps over small logs. Then he swims in the lake. He is very fit.

After sport, Tom eats lunch with his sister, Anna. They cook pasta together. Anna cuts the vegetables and Tom stirs the sauce. Later, they wash the dishes.

questions.text: What does Tom do every morning?

options: He eats a lot of sweets.

questions.text: What can we guess about Tom and Anna?

vocabulary.definition: moves through water using arms and legs
mixes food in a pot with a spoon
healthy and strong in the body

paragraph_translations: Tom lubi sport. Każdego ranka biega w parku. Przeskakuje przez małe kłody. Potem pływa w jeziorze. Jest bardzo sprawny.
Po sporcie Tom je obiad ze swoją siostrą, Anną. Razem gotują makaron. Anna kroi warzywa, a Tom miesza sos. Później myją naczynia.
